name: 递物交接
description: 一角色把物件递向另一角色：递者前伸手、接物在两手之间临界点，接者伸手迎
requires: 传递道具 + 递者 + 接者（双人同框）

generation.promptTemplate: {giverAnchor}, extending arm offering {propAnchor} toward the receiver, {receiverAnchor} reaching out to receive, the object visibly between both hands at the handover moment, warm interaction, both facing each other
generation.negativeExtra: object floating far from hands, object on floor, both standing idle, backs turned, object held only by one side with no handover
generation.note: 递者+接者+物烘成一张图（双人载体变体），三方不得分离

placement.note: 双人载体变体替换两个独立摆位与该道具摆位

acceptance: 递者手臂前伸、接者伸手迎（交接临界）
物在两手之间（不在单方手中握死、不落地）
人物数量与剧情一致（不得多/少人）
